verdict_text:
NO

The artifact violates the ordering requirement in step 2 (and the explicitly called-out hazard in "Why it is meaningful"): the second task vector is computed against `tmp` (the already-modified intermediate), not against the unmodified `base`. Concretely, `out[X] = tmp + λ(f2 - tmp)` expands to `(1-λ)²·base + λ(1-λ)·ft1 + λ·ft2`, whereas the spec requires `base + λ(ft1-base) + λ(ft2-base) = (1-2λ)·base + λ·ft1 + λ·ft2`. With λ=0.4 these give base-coefficients of 0.36 vs. 0.2 and ft1-coefficients of 0.24 vs. 0.4 — a large, systematic deviation, not a rounding-order difference the 1e-3 tolerance would absorb. This will fail the grading script's relative-Frobenius-error check on the 64 merged tensors.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
